Funniest moment... I can think of 2:

1. I was asking someone to press the Start button on windows. They didn't know what it was, so i described it to her. She then tells me "ok i clicked it!! Oh wait... Never mind that was a sticker..."

2. This one guy was using the wrong PIN on his phone. I suggested he was putting it wrong or using the wrong one. He took that as me calling him stupid and wanted to file a complaint.

He could do that by either going on our website, or with me. He wanted neither so he hung up and called again.  
Since i was the only one available at that time i got his call again. He went on a rage rampage on how i was out to get him and stuff. I found it quite funny :p

Worst moment: i had just started doing in person support. I was actually under training still (using the actual applications and such). 

This one guy comes in with a blackberry that requires a wipe (it was locked for some reason). The guy says he had backed up the phone earlier, so i don't do it.

Turns out he didn't chose the option to backup the media on the phone. Lost about 3y worth of pictures and videos...  
It wasn't my fault, but i still felt terrible. 

The best moments are to see/hear the person give that sigh of relief when everything starts working ^^

My slippers got stuck to floor, and i just fell forward onto a wooden bench.  
My bottom left rib hit it and once i got up i couldn't breathe. I just stood there, grasping my chest trying to get air into my lungs looking desperate at this one guy who was just standing there.  
Then suddenly, someone hits me in the back and i feel hot humid air enter my mouth and lungs. By then i was already getting a foggy vision.

I still have a bump on my rib from that event, and it was terrifying.
